verse.text: The godly walk with integrity; blessed are their children who follow them.

video.title: What Is Integrity? | Ask Pastor Rick

reflection: Your kids aren't grading your sermons — they're grading your Tuesday nights: whether you keep the small promise, tell the hard truth, and stay the same guy at home as you are everywhere else. Integrity isn't a one-time stand; it's the quiet, repeated choice to do right when no one but your family is watching. That's the inheritance that outlasts anything money can buy.
